The first quest for anyone starting in {wiki:Newhaven|Newhaven}. You help the guard {npc:Gustavo, The Guard} drive off the goblins of the Muglex Clan and recover the book stolen from teacher {npc:Viola}, while levelling up to level 8 so you can travel to {wiki:Targuna|Targuna}. You receive a {item:Guardian Ring}, a {item:Scarf} and 1,600 experience points.
The adventure begins! Start your journey in the world of Tibia by helping the inhabitants of Newhaven, gaining experience and training your combat skills against the creatures.
A new character that started in Newhaven (the quest is assigned automatically when you choose your vocation).
Accept both missions (Protect the Village and Lost Wisdom) at the same time and do everything in one go.
You will probably reach level 8 before you finish the missions: finish them anyway before going to Targuna, for the rewards.

This mission is assigned automatically when you arrive at the main island of Newhaven, right after choosing your vocation. The goal is to reach **level 8** and travel to {wiki:Targuna|Targuna}. Along the way, do the two missions below.
Talk to {npc:Gustavo, The Guard}: say {key:hi} and {key:goblins}. He asks you to kill **20** Muglex Clan goblins.

Kill 20 Muglex Clan goblins ({creature:Muglex Clan Footman|Footmen}, {creature:Muglex Clan Assassin|Assassins}; the leader is the {creature:Muglex Clan Chief}). They are at the {wiki:Muglex Clan Camp|Muglex Clan Camp}, in the **northwest** of the island: leave the village through the **north** exit, which leads to the hunting area. To return, take the same path **south** back to the village.
They are small but can be dangerous for a newly created character. Heal whenever you need to.
Go back to {npc:Gustavo, The Guard} and say {key:hi} and {key:goblins}. You receive the {item:Guardian Ring} and 800 experience.
Talk to {npc:Viola}: {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. A ghost stole her {item:Book of Wisdom} and disappeared into the mines, in the **northeast** part of the island.
Recovering the book in the mines

Go to the {wiki:Corrupted Mines|Corrupted Mines}, the old coal mine in the **northeast** of the island (leave the village through the **north** exit), and recover the {item:Book of Wisdom}. Then go back the same way to the village.
The corrupted creatures ({creature:Corrupted Ghost|Corrupted Ghosts}, {creature:Corrupted Skeleton|Corrupted Skeletons} and {creature:The Corruptor}) are part of this quest's dangers.
Go back to {npc:Viola} and say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. You receive the {item:Scarf} and 800 experience.

When you reach **level 8**, leave the village through the **west** exit (a level door that only opens from level 8) and go to the docks. Talk to {npc:Anna}: {key:hi}, {key:passage} and {key:yes}. She takes you to {wiki:Targuna|Targuna}, where you finish *Welcome to Newhaven* and continue your adventure.
The trip is one-way: once you leave Newhaven you can never come back. Finish the missions before you board.
